sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Focus on comprehensive onboard experience (food, beverages, entertainment, spacious seats), flexible flight change/cancellation policies, a robust mobile app for end-to-end trip management, and extensive route network.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Delta Air Lines is a major global airline providing passenger air transportation services, including flight booking, travel planning, and various onboard experiences. They offer tools for managing flights, finding deals, and engaging with their loyalty program.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Commercial airline flights
flight deals
premium travel cabins (e.g.
Delta Premium Select)
SkyMiles loyalty program
Delta AMEX Credit Cards
Gift Cards
Fly Delta mobile app
travel planning tools
customer service.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Varies based on destination, cabin class, time of booking; includes basic economy, main cabin, premium select, first class, Delta One. Also gift cards and loyalty program benefits.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Leisure travelers, business travelers, travel agents.
